title: Umhlebi Wegolide Ehlane
intro: Cabanga ngekamu elikhulu elisehlane ngesikhathi sokulinda nokungaqiniseki. Umholi omkhulu uye waya emhlanganweni noNkulunkulu, eshiya umphakathi olangazelela okuthile okuphathekayo angakubamba. Kulokho kuthula okungapheli, umuntu okholisayo uya phambili enezithembiso ezikhazimulayo kanye nesidalwa esihlakaniphile esibonakala siphila.
clues: Ngangiphakathi kwalabo abashiya iGibhithe noMose, ngibona ulwandle luhlukana ukuze sibaleke.
Ngabuka lapho umholi wethu eya entabeni ubusuku obungamashumi amane ukuze athole isiqondiso.
Ngaqoqa imihlobiso kubantu futhi ngayibumba ngezandla zami.
Ngakha ithole elalikhipha umsindo wokubhonga, futhi ngabiza abantu ukuba beze kulo.
Ngathatha uthuli oluncane emzileni wesithunywa ngaluphonsa kulokho engangikwenzile.
Ngabhekana noMusa futhi ngagwetshwa ukuthi ngithi 'ungangithinti' futhi nihlale ngokwehlukana, ngesithembiso somhlangano wokwahlulela.

trial.label: Isivivinyo/Umcimbi
options: Ukukhulekelwa okufunwayo njengenkosi ephakeme kunazo zonke eGibhithe
Wakha umkhumbi ukuze asinde kuzamcolo omkhulu
Wayala umlilo omkhulu ukuba ushise u-Ibrahim

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Ugwetshwe ukuthi athi 'ungangithinti' eyedwa elinde isahlulelo
outcome.answer: Ugwetshwe ukuthi athi 'ungangithinti' eyedwa elinde isahlulelo

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
